usedFor: Password.link shares secrets through expiring links, and “Create Secret Request” makes a link that lets someone send one.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking Created” in Recras, then “Create Secret Request” in Password.link
bestTemplate.why: A new booking creates a request link, so a client has a protected way to send credentials.

watchOut: “Delete Secret Request” in Password.link deletes by Request ID, so keep the ID from “Create Secret Request”.
